title: The Withdrawal Trap
intro: This is Mirage's biggest con. A friend of Toddy's, Kiko, joined Brenvoy Trade Pro months ago.
Kiko asked Toddy to handle the withdrawal. Mirage will change faces twice.
Collect the clues. At the end, unmask him on the case board.

screen.context: Kiko deposited €2,000 in total. The site now shows a huge balance.

msg.text: If the tax isn't paid in 24 hours, the account is frozen forever.

replies.text: Why can't you take the tax from the balance?
Stop. Stop paying and report this.

msg.text: System rules, sorry 🙏 The balance is locked until the fee arrives.

replies.text: Real platforms take fees from the balance. Report it.
Kiko should report this to the police first

sys.text: Agent Mia left. "Recovery Agent · Hollenor Legal Europe" messaged you.

msg.text: For a €500 fee we recover 100% of your funds.

replies.text: "Recovery agents" who charge first are a second scam. Report both.
Kiko will report to the police directly

balance.label: Too-good balance
balance.lens: €2,000 in, €12,480 on screen. Numbers on a fake site mean nothing.
balance.why: Fake platforms show huge gains so you pay more.

tax.label: Pay "tax" first
tax.lens: A "tax" you must pay before you get anything.
tax.why: Real taxes aren't paid to the platform's crypto wallet.

frozen.label: Frozen-forever threat
frozen.lens: Pay in 24 hours or lose it all.
frozen.why: Deadlines and threats stop you checking.

rules.label: "System rules"
rules.lens: An excuse for why they can't take the fee from the balance.
rules.why: If the balance were real, they could deduct the fee from it.

swap.label: New face appears
swap.lens: Right after the first trick, a "recovery agent" turns up.
swap.why: Scammers sell lists of victims, or come back in a new costume.

recovery.label: Paid "recovery"
recovery.lens: They promise 100% back, for a fee up front.
recovery.why: Recovery scams target people who've already lost money.

brand.label: Company name
brand.why: Any site can name its support desk. Proves nothing alone.

actions.label: Tell Kiko to report it to the police
Stop paying and report the platform

block_report.line: No more money went in. The report helped investigators link the fake platform and the fake recovery agent.

verify.line: The police confirmed: no real tax, no real recovery agents. Kiko paid nothing more.

go_ahead.line: The tax, then the recovery fee. Both went to the same con artist.

what_if.go_ahead: Paying to unlock money, then paying to "recover" it, is the same scam twice. Stop paying and report.
what_if.verify: Going to the police was right. Reporting the platform as well helps others.

verdicts.text: A fake platform, then a fake recovery agent: the same con twice
Real profits, a real tax and a real lawyer

board.explain: Pay-to-withdraw, a frozen-account threat, then a paid "recovery". One con artist, two masks.

golden_rule: Never pay to get money back. Fees to withdraw and fees to "recover" are the same scam.

quick_check.q: Someone offers to recover your lost crypto for a fee. What do you do?

options.text: Don't pay; report to the police yourself

quick_check.explain: Real police don't charge you to investigate.

hints.nudge: Ask yourself: why must you pay before you get anything?

rows.v: They cannot take it from your balance

rows.k: Fee to withdraw your own money?
Recovery for a fee up front?
